economic_hypothesis.statement: Bars where aggressive taker flow is strongly one-sided (|OFI| >= 0.30) while market participation is elevated (trade count >= 1.5x its trailing norm) mark directional pressure from impatient/informed traders that tends to PERSIST into the following bars; entering WITH the flow side at the next bar open and holding a fixed horizon monetizes that persistence.
economic_hypothesis.is_not: price-pattern momentum, regime-state conditioning, relative-value reversion, carry, session timing; NOT a repackaging of FAILED_RESEARCH_MEMORY #1-#11
economic_hypothesis.mechanism: flow continuation (WITH the aggressive side), in contrast to H3's refuted reversion premise

data.source: committed frozen 12-field klines (docs/external-audit-01/h1-regime-transition-01/dataset/{ASSET}_1h.jsonl); fields: openTime, open, high, low, close, volume, closeTime, quoteVolume, numberOfTrades, takerBuyBaseVolume, takerBuyQuoteVolume, ignore
data.fingerprint_rule: sha256 per asset file recorded at execution; no synthetic rows
data.per_asset_evaluation: assets evaluated independently and pooled for the headline metrics; no cross-asset pairing

features.order_flow_imbalance: OFI_t = (2*takerBuyBaseVolume_t - volume_t) / volume_t  [in (-1, +1]; = +1 all taker-buy, -1 all taker-sell]
features.participation: P_t = numberOfTrades_t / SMA(numberOfTrades, 336 bars ending at t)
features.normalization: OFI z-scored against trailing 336-bar mean/std of OFI (zOFI_t); participation uses its own trailing norm (P_t)
features.pit_semantics: OFI_t, zOFI_t, P_t use ONLY bars with close_time <= decision_time; trailing 336-bar windows; no full-window statistics, no future normalization

direction_rules.entry_long: zOFI_t >= +2.5 AND P_t >= 1.5 AND flat (flow strongly buy-sided at elevated participation)
direction_rules.entry_short: zOFI_t <= -2.5 AND P_t >= 1.5 AND flat (flow strongly sell-sided at elevated participation)
direction_rules.entry_instant: next bar open (bar t+1) = the fill instant of the decision; no lookahead
direction_rules.exit_rule: fixed horizon: exit at close of bar t+12 (HOLD_BARS=12; the hypothesis is about the IMMEDIATE continuation window, matching the 1h flow-memory horizon)
direction_rules.stop_invalidation: adverse move of 1.0 x trailing ATR14 (window t-13..t) from entry, checked pessimistically (stop assumed first when SL and horizon land in one bar; same frozen convention as H1)
direction_rules.incomplete_tail: transitions without 12 remaining bars are skipped and counted (mechanical completeness)

cost_model.cost_basis: identical to frozen H1 cost basis (5 bps/side binanceusdm taker reference)
cost_model.accounting: ABSOLUTE semantics (DEF-RESEARCH-COST-001): net_r = gross_r - (10/10000)/(ATR14/entry); cost scenarios 0/5/10/20/40 bps recomputed with absolute anchoring only
cost_model.funding: N/A — single-asset 1h horizon with 12-bar exits; perp funding is a separate mechanism (declared ex ante; materiality assessed post-run only if a gate passes)

robustness_gates.cost_sensitivity: absolute semantics, scenarios 0/5/10/20/40 bps RT + preregistered 5/20 reporting
robustness_gates.direction_stability: both LONG and SHORT cells reported; pass does not require both positive, but a single-direction-only result must be labeled DIRECTION_ASYMMETRIC

measurables: trade-time overlap vs frozen ROC(24) proxy
daily PnL correlation on common days
trade-time overlap + daily PnL correlation vs deterministic H1 and H3 replays
orthogonality_gates.redundant_candidate_rule: trade-time overlap > 0.6 AND daily PnL correlation > 0.7 vs ANY comparison family -> REDUNDANT_CANDIDATE even if raw PF attractive

execution_protocol.exactly_once: single economic execution via the ResearchExecutionLedger (STARTED persisted + fsync'd BEFORE any economic work; attempt rows append-only; recovery = new attempt_id with RECOVERY_OF link)
execution_protocol.ordering_rule: H5 execution commit MUST be strictly later than this preregistration commit
execution_protocol.no_peeking: no performance statistic may be computed or observed before the economic execution
execution_protocol.marker: H5_EXECUTION_MARKER.json (completion marker) written before H5_RESULT.json; authority and attempts live in the ledger

promotion_boundary: DISCOVERY_PASS -> PREPARE_H5_CONFIRMATION_MANIFEST on an UNSEEN window only (no PAPER, no confirmation shortcut); DISCOVERY_FAIL -> FAILED_RESEARCH_MEMORY #12; INSUFFICIENT_* -> allowed re-entry with deeper data only
